attempts.answer:
**Product & Domain:** LinkedIn (`linkedin.com`)

**Direct Vendor / Operating Company:** **LinkedIn Corporation** (and **LinkedIn Ireland Unlimited Company** for users located in the European Union, European Economic Area, and Switzerland).

**Provider Statement:**
According to Section 1.1 of the LinkedIn User Agreement (`linkedin.com/legal/user-agreement`):
> *"This Contract applies to LinkedIn.com, LinkedIn-branded apps, LinkedIn Learning and other LinkedIn-related sites, apps, communications, and other services that state that they are offered under this Contract (“Services”)... If you reside in the “Designated Countries” [EU, EEA, and Switzerland], you are entering into this Contract with LinkedIn Ireland Unlimited Company... If you reside outside of the “Designated Countries”, you are entering into this Contract with LinkedIn Corporation..."*

record.description: LinkedIn is a leading professional networking platform that connects individuals and businesses worldwide. LinkedIn, founded in 2002, is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California.
